Large side-by-side compilation ('goodbyeRRsidebyside') pairing November 2018 news headlines about Rod Rosenstein losing oversight of the Mueller probe to acting AG Matthew Whitaker with earlier Q posts that said 'Goodbye, Mr. Rosenstein', plus headlines and Q/anon posts about Jeff Sessions, John Huber, and Mueller. Presented as proof the Q posts predicted the news; bottom caption reads 'Nothing can stop what is coming. Nothing.' The compilation implies predictive validation, which is an interpretive claim by its maker.

description: Screenshot of Q post #1559 (tripcode !CbboFOtcZs, No.1813048, June 19 2018) about DECLAS. A red box added by the poster highlights the lines quoting 'Viva Le Resistance.' and contrasting 'Viv[a] vs Viv[e]' — the phrase a 2018 DOJ IG report attributed to an FBI attorney's text message. The post uses initials 'LP' and '[J C]' and asks why a title was classified and about a role with Mueller; the bracketed-letter wordplay is the drop's claim.
text: Q !CbboFOtcZs ID: 9ddda6 No.1813048 1559. Jun 19 2018 10:53:55 (EST). DECLAS. LP "Viva Le Resistance.". Viv[a] vs Viv[e]. [J C]. Why classified by intel comm @ highest level?. Define title. Define role w/ Mueller. Exchange shelters VERY senior member. Q
flags: Initials 'LP' and '[J C]' are commonly interpreted by readers as specific officials but the post does not name anyone; interpretation left to the reader
